title: PM daily scratchpad — launch prep: hosted-api v2
content:
Quick notes from today (rough)

Context: final whitespace work for Hosted API v2 launch. Focused on PRD clarity, rollout gating, and owner follow-ups. Keeping this as my single source-of-truth for what still needs doing.

Top goals for the day:
- Finish PRD edits around SLOs and fallback model variants (see section 'Fallback behavior' — needs clearer examples)
- Lock release checklist and get sign-off from infra + SRE
- Confirm canary timing and metrics with SRE (latency p95 target + error budget threshold)

PRD edits (quick todo)
- [ ] Add explicit SLO numbers (p50/p95/p99) for generation and embeddings endpoints — decide default vs tenant-overrides (open question: default p95 = 250ms or 300ms?) -> ACTION: ask SRE (Ethan) by EOD
- [ ] Clarify fallback flow: when model variant unavailable, route to 'compatible-quantized' variant and include response header X-Model-Fallback (design in PRD but needs example response)
- [ ] Add example request/response for streaming + function-calls (copy from SDK repo example) -> PR: linked
- [ ] Document reversion plan for bad rollout (A/B -> full rollback steps)

Stakeholder follow-ups
- Priya: docs + SDK changelog update (she's updating examples) — check-in 3pm
- SRE (Ethan): confirm canary metrics and alert thresholds — pinged in slack #sre-canary, waiting for confirmation
- Legal: privacy blurb for usage-based telemetry — need final wording by Thurs (PROJ-931)

Launch checklist (working, not final)
- Pre-launch:
  - [x] Finalize API contract PR (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/829)
  - [ ] Deploy canary (2% traffic) to eu-west and us-west clusters
  - [ ] Run smoke tests (end-to-end) against canary -> owners: qa (Marta), infra (Ethan)
  - [ ] Docs: quickstart + breaking-changes note posted (owner: Priya)
  - [ ] Billing: confirm metering tags and cost dashboard updates (owner: finance ops)
  - [ ] API keys: rotate internal deploy keys and verify CI access (owner: release eng)

- Post-canary validations:
  - [ ] Confirm p95 latency within target for 72h window
  - [ ] No regression in output quality for 10 eval prompts (run eval suite) -> owner: applied-ml
  - [ ] Cost per token baseline recorded and compared to previous version

Open issues / blockers
- Infra: cache dedup bug (ticket PROJ-914) can cause cold latency spikes — infra says mitigation ready but not yet merged. If not merged, we may need to increase canary gradually.
- SDK: streaming client needs small fix for flush semantics on Node 18 (PR created, not yet approved)
- Monitoring: need a dashboard tile for 'fallback rate' (how often we route to fallback model). SRE flagged this as required for rollout.

Today schedule (rough)
- 09:30 — sync with Priya (docs + release notes)
- 10:30 — PRD walkthrough with product design (10–15m)
- 11:00 — engineering standup -> raise canary gate concern
- 14:00 — sync with SRE (Ethan) on metrics and alerts
- 15:00 — check-in with Priya on SDK docs
- 16:30 — sign-off meeting (tentative) with eng leads if canary ready

Notes to self
- Keep PRD language simple: "what happens to customer requests" > internal infra details. Link infra specifics to internal runbook.
- Add a short paragraph in PRD about tenant opt-in for experimental batching (makes rollout safer).
- Remember to update Console rollout UI: route flags + per-tenant opt-in description (ask console team to add copy)

Quick links:
- PRD draft: Confluence: PROD-Launch-Checklist-2026
- Main API PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/829
- Jira (primary): PROJ-931

Tomorrow:
- Re-check canary after 24h, capture metrics snapshot and send to stakeholders
- If green, increase canary to 20% and run full regression evals

Unresolved questions (to raise in sign-off)
- Exact p95 SLO default (250ms vs 300ms)
- Whether to include X-Model-Fallback header by default or behind a feature flag

End of notes.

(Updating this doc as things move — will trim and copy into PRD and checklist once stable)
